interface.shortDescription: SEO and AEO for your brand
interface.longDescription:
GoBlinkly is an SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) workspace for marketing teams and the agencies that run their sites. Sign in with your GoBlinkly account and ask questions about the brands you already have access to.

What you can do:
- AI search visibility: share of voice against tracked competitors, citation trends and gaps, and prompt-level rankings.
- Classic search: traffic, keyword and Search Console query trends from the brand's connected Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 properties.
- Backlinks: the backlink profile, new and lost links, and referring domains.
- Site audits: the audit checklist, issues per page, and the exact failing check on a specific URL.
- Blog content: list and read the brand's blog posts, see which posts have audit issues, draft new posts, and edit titles, meta descriptions and body text. Publish or unpublish posts on the brand's connected custom site.
- Brand setup: maintain the competitor list, brand profile, tasks and notes.

Who it is for: in-house marketers and agencies managing the SEO and AI-search presence of their own or their clients' sites.

Limitations: every tool works only on brands the signed-in user has been granted access to; nothing outside that grant is reachable. Search and analytics data appear only when the brand has connected Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 in GoBlinkly. Changes that edit or remove content act on a real post, so ChatGPT asks for confirmation first. Brands that publish to Webflow or Shopify must have that site connected in GoBlinkly. GoBlinkly does not give legal, financial or medical advice.
defaultPrompt: What are the biggest technical SEO issues on my site?
How often is my brand mentioned in AI answers compared to my competitors?
Which of my blog posts have SEO problems and what are they?
